producer_report.summary:
I added a `[capabilities.study]` section to athena.toml that mirrors the change capability: the same producer and verifier commands, the same env, and the fmt, clippy and test checks. No other table changed, and I added no firstmate pinning. athena.toml is the governance file changed; the CHANGELOG says so and notes the section governs only later jobs.

I renamed the study crate's test to `the_verifier_never_writes_and_grants_and_checks_come_from_the_config`. It now asserts that `capability("study")` is present. It also asserts that both command sets and the env match the section, and that the checks are fmt, clippy, test. I updated the CHANGELOG's earlier "no configured checks or commands yet" line, which the new section made untrue.

`cargo test --locked`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check` all pass.

checks_run.note: all suites ok, 0 failed (re-run with -q to read the summary)

open_issues: Firstmate pinning is left for the next job, as scoped.
learnings: The study crate's job_config test helper loads the repo's athena.toml, so adding the section is what the test reads.
Grep and Read are denied on the tool-results spill file outside the working directory; use cargo test -q to get a short summary.
